conversation.text: Hi, I need to schedule a service call. My AC is making a loud grinding noise.
I'm sorry your AC is making a grinding noise, and I can help get a service call started.
First, please give me your full name and one of the following: your account number, your service address, or your phone number.
Sure, it's Elena Foster, 512-730-9305.
Thank you, Elena.
I have three HVAC repair slots open on Monday, 19 October 2026: 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM, 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM, or 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
Which one suits you?
Is there anything for tomorrow afternoon? If not, I'd like to know if you can do anything earlier than Monday.
I checked, and nothing earlier than Monday is available, so there is nothing for tomorrow afternoon.
The earliest slots are all on Monday, 19 October 2026, each for HVAC repair: 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM, 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM, or 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
Which one suits you?
I've passed this to our team: Ticket #1. Someone will contact you within one business day. You can keep asking me other questions here.
Okay, do that. And book the slot, please.
I can book that for you, but I need to know which slot you'd like.
The available HVAC repair slots are Monday, 19 October 2026 from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM, Monday, 19 October 2026 from 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM, and Monday, 19 October 2026 from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
Which one suits you, or is there another time that works better?
Since I wanted the afternoon, the 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM slot on Monday works. Please book that one.
Just to confirm, I would book an HVAC repair for Monday, 19 October 2026, in the 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM window.
Can you give me a clear yes to go ahead with that booking?
Yes, please go ahead and book that one.
Booked: your HVAC repair visit on Monday, October 19, 12pm to 4pm, with Ray Mendoza.
Thanks. Is there anything I need to know before the visit, like whether the unit's under warranty? I think it's whatever was there when we moved in.
The facts don't say whether your unit is under warranty, since that depends on details they don't cover, such as who installed it and when.

The Warranty Policy says Meridian's 1-year repair labor warranty applies only to repairs Meridian performed, and its 2-year installation labor warranty applies only to full system installations Meridian did.
Manufacturer parts warranties are separate and vary by brand.
For the visit itself, the Warranty Policy says that if a technician determines a failure is not covered, the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies, and if it is covered there is no diagnostic fee.

The Before You Call: Quick Checks document lists things to check before a visit, for example for a furnace that won't turn on: thermostat set to HEAT above room temperature, furnace switch ON, breaker, and filter.
For an AC that isn't cooling, check the thermostat is set to COOL, the filter, the breaker, and the outdoor unit.
I've added that to Ticket #1; our team will contact you within one business day.
No, that's it. Thanks.
Thanks for contacting Meridian Home Comfort. Have a great day.
